intellectual_contributions: Joint taxonomy covering 35 essential Indian dietary classes formulated by the student research team at PCCOE Pune.
First benchmark dataset systematically resolving Indian thali staple blind spots: Yellow Dal, Dal Makhani, Jeera Rice, Steamed Rice, and Onion Salad.
Comprehensive automated purification pipeline removing 290 stock-watermarked items, producing 7,351 pristine raw culinary vision records.
Algorithmic synthetic domain randomization: Gaussian lens defocus blur (sigma 1.8-3.5), directional motion blur (camera shake simulation), and low-light illuminance reduction (factors 0.55-0.78).
